data.title: Thyme at Central Park
data.about:
Welcome to Central Park Thyme at City Walk by Meraas, where city living meets the tranquillity of nature. Imagine waking up to the breathtaking views of Dubai’s skyline surrounded by lush greenery. Central Park at City Walk by Meraas offers an array of luxurious 1 to 4-bedroom apartments with unmatched opulence and grandeur. 

Thyme at City Walk by Meraas is set in the heart of Dubai, offering an authentic park lifestyle experience that blurs the lines between urban and nature. Here, you can take refuge in the lush green landscapes and indulge in countless activities, all within your private park.

Central Park at City Walk by Meraas is surrounded by some of the city’s finest restaurants, world-class hotels, massive shopping centres, and fantastic leisure and entertainment outlets, making it a perfect location to experience the best of both worlds. Experience the magic of living in a lush green oasis in the city’s heart.

characteristics_module.title: Luxurious and spacious apartments measuring over 2000 SQ FT
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Prices start from AED 2M with a 70 / 30 payment plan
  • Jungle-themed aesthetic for a unique living experience
  • Spacious apartments available in sizes ranging from 1 to 4 bedrooms
  • Exclusive pet parks available for your furry companions
  • Located in the highly sought-after City Walk neighborhood
  • Enjoy breathtaking views of Dubai’s iconic skyscrapers
  • Exclusive private parks for residents to enjoy

location_tile.title: Experience the epitome of urban living in Thyme at Central Park by Meraas, where convenient connectivity meets lush greenery in the heart of Dubai Riverside is situated in one of Dubai’s most prestigious neighborhoods, Sobha Hartland 2
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Discover a world of effortless elegance and luxury as you indulge in these stunning residences’ sophisticated amenities and contemporary design. Located between Al Wasl Road and Sheikh Zayed Road, you’ll have quick and easy access to major landmarks and entertainment hubs, making it the perfect fusion of convenience and comfort. Come home to the ultimate urban oasis, where the best of both worlds awaits.

  • 01 minutes to City Walk
  • 10 minutes to Jumeirah Beach
  • 15 minutes to Dubai International Airport
  • 15 minutes to Burj Al Arab
  • 15 minutes to La Mer Beach
